is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) and Anopheles funestus (Page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study evaluates in vitro cytochrome P450 enzyme interactions (IC50 and depletion) and re-analyses previously published WHO susceptibility test data; it does not report genotyping of any target resistance markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype counts, allele counts, or genotype frequencies are reported in the paper.

african_field_population.evidence: While the bioassay data re-analysed in the study originates from African field populations, no field mosquito samples were genotyped for target resistance markers in this study.

is_primary_study.evidence: For vector susceptibility and resistance data, this paper re-analyses a previously published database of vector susceptibility tests (Moyes et al. 2019, Sci Data).

sub_country_location.evidence: No specific field collection site genotype data are presented.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No field genotyping temporal collection windows are presented.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The susceptibility test data analysed in this paper was accessed directly from a published database of insecticide resistance in African malaria vectors (Moyes et al. 2019, Sci Data 6:121 [ref 14]).

supplement.evidence: Supplementary files do not contain primary marker genotyping data.

assessment.summary: This paper combines in vitro recombinant cytochrome P450 enzyme inhibition/depletion assays with a re-analysis of a previously published WHO susceptibility bioassay database to assess cross-resistance patterns among pyrethroids. It does not perform or report genotyping of target insecticide resistance markers.
exclusion_reasons: Does not genotype any target insecticide-resistance markers.
Does not report extractable genotype data.
Re-analyses existing published bioassay datasets rather than presenting primary field marker genotype data.
